decisions.reason: The interchangeable-disc music box line is presented as the firm's flagship and new direction, so management will likely keep supporting it despite its distance from the core craft offer and its lack of website visibility in 2020–2021.

The Christmas motif platform is a low-prominence accessory, its sister platform was already withdrawn, and it was not visible on the website in recent years, which makes it a natural candidate for range trimming.
The Dresden-themed pyramid builds directly on the firm's traditional pyramid craftsmanship and appeals to collectors, so it fits the core business and is worth keeping.
